description: This Java interface defines a set of utilities and functions for hashing, including Murmur-3 hash functions and SHA-256 digest functions. It provides methods to generate hash values for strings using different seeds and algorithms, which can be used in distributed hashing or data partitioning scenarios.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns a collection of seed integers used for hashing.

methods.name: getHashes
methods.description: Generates a list of hash codes for a given string using the set of seeds.

methods.name: murmurHash
methods.description: Calculates a Murmur-3 hash for a string with a specific seed.

methods.name: digestStringsToIntegers
methods.description: Produces a list of pseudorandom integers derived from a string seed by repeatedly applying SHA-256 digest.
